name: a genuine catalog-matched Elder+ pick shows its real catalog tier
a keep_custom power with a real derived level shows that level, not "(elder)"
a keep_custom power with no derivable level falls back to its own stored tier text, not the hardcoded default
a keep_custom power with neither a level nor a stored tier still falls back to "elder", never undefined
numericLabel: an ordinary numbered rung with no power_name just shows the level
numericLabel: a power_name entry defers to elderLabel even in numeric mode
namedLabel: a power_name entry defers to elderLabel regardless of the level argument
namedLabel: an ordinary numbered rung looks up the real power_name for that level
prefixes "Tradition: " onto a rendered label when the held pick carries one
renders unchanged when the held pick carries no tradition - every ordinary discipline
named mode shows the specific level name, still tradition-prefixed - a player sees the flavor name, not just the bare path
lists every named rung from 1 up to the held level for a plain numbered holding
lists nothing for a held level of 0
lists only the one specific power for an Elder-and-above pick - there is no stack beneath it
a non-sequential block still expands the full stack, not just the current rung
lists every tied power at that rank, not just one
a tied rank and an untied rank both resolve correctly in the same stack
